protocol.title: Sperm-seq wet lab protocol: sperm preparation and droplet-based sequencing library generation
protocol.platform: Droplet-based single-sperm sequencing (10X Genomics GemCode, Option 1)
affiliations: Department of Genetics, Harvard Medical School
Program in Medical and Population Genetics, Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
protocol.objective: High-throughput cell-barcoded single-sperm sequencing library generation via sperm nucleus decondensation followed by droplet-based GEM barcoding on a 10X Genomics GemCode platform

buffer_SMT.composition: 250 mM sucrose, 5 mM MgCl2, 10 mM Tris pH 7.5
buffer_SMT.purpose: Freeze-thaw buffer; protects sperm membrane osmolarity during liquid nitrogen cycling
buffer_SMT.recipe_10mL: 2500 uL 1M sucrose + 50 uL 1M MgCl2 + 100 uL 1M Tris pH 7.5 + 7350 uL ultrapure water

buffer_DB.composition: 113 mM KCl, 12.5 mM KH2PO4, 2.5 mM Na2HPO4, 2.5 mM MgCl2, 20 mM Tris pH 7.5

BME.purpose: Reduces protamine disulfide crosslinks to release sperm chromatin

buffer_DB.purpose: Salt decondensation buffer; freshly prepared with heparin and BME before use

heparinase.purpose: Removes heparin post-decondensation to eliminate PCR inhibition

SYBR_green_I.dilution_for_count: 1:100 (1 uL sperm + 10 uL 10X SYBR + 89 uL PBS)
SYBR_green_I.purpose: Fluorescent DNA stain for hemocytometer counting; decondensed sperm appear as large bright circles

GemCode_reagents.bead_dilution: 1:11 in ultrapure water (>=90 uL per sample); vortex full speed 25 s before dilution

equipment.tubes: Nonstick 1.5 mL microfuge tubes (ThermoFisher Scientific AM12450)

steps.name: Thaw and transfer sperm aliquot
steps.condition: room temperature thaw; quick spin before transfer to nonstick tube
steps.notes: Nonstick tubes critical to minimise cell loss during subsequent washes

steps.name: First PBS wash
steps.bioscript_heat_abstraction: heat at 4c for 10m models cold centrifugation step
steps.notes: Remove supernatant after spin; resuspend in 10 uL PBS

steps.name: Resuspend in Buffer SMT
steps.notes: Protects membrane integrity during subsequent freeze-thaw cycles

steps.name: Freeze-thaw cycles x3
steps.procedure_per_cycle: submerge in liquid N2 5-10 s, uncap to de-pressurise, hold in fist until thawed
steps.bioscript_note: No loop constructs in BioScript; 3 cycles unrolled as 6 sequential heat calls on spermInSMT

steps.name: Prepare Buffer DB with heparin and BME
steps.notes: Prepare fresh immediately before use; BME used in fume hood

steps.name: Chromatin decondensation in Buffer DB
steps.notes: BME reduces protamine disulfide bonds; heparin prevents chromatin aggregation

steps.name: Heparinase treatment
steps.thaw_condition: on ice during last half of 37C incubation (Step 7)
steps.purpose: Removes heparin to eliminate PCR inhibition in downstream library generation
steps.dataflow_note: spermDecondensed is the terminal output of the full prep chain; consumed directly by Step 11 (library dilution)

steps.name: SYBR Green I staining for cell counting
steps.dilution: 1:100 (1 uL sperm + 10 uL 10X SYBR + 89 uL PBS)

incubation.condition: dark, with or without gentle rotation

steps.bioscript_abstraction_note: BioScript has no split operation. The 1 uL counting sub-sample is modelled as SpermCountAliquot_Decondensed (a manifest explicitly named to identify its physical source: post-heparinase decondensed stock). The bulk stock (spermDecondensed) flows unbroken into Step 11.

steps.name: Hemocytometer cell count
steps.counting_method: 5 big squares under green fluorescent light; concentration = count x 100 cells/uL
steps.morphology_note: Decondensed sperm appear as large bright fluorescent circles; non-decondensed appear as compact dots

steps.name: Dilute sperm to target concentration
steps.notes: spermDecondensed is consumed here -- primary end-to-end dataflow from prep chain to library

steps.name: Combine sperm with master mix
steps.notes: Pipette gently with wide-bore tips to prevent shearing of decondensed sperm chromatin

steps.name: Prepare GemCode beads
steps.bioscript_note: Two sequential mix steps chain to accumulate dilution water; compiler ignores multi-unit volume scalars

steps.name: Load GemCode chip
steps.notes: Droplet generation: GemCode controller partitions into GEMs (Gel Bead in Emulsions); single sperm barcoded per GEM

steps.name: GEM incubation and library construction
steps.library_construction_reference: GemCode User Guide Rev C Steps 5.36-6.2.6
steps.QC_method: Bioanalyzer/qPCR fragment size and yield check
steps.sequencing: Illumina sequencer; sequence yield improved by slightly increasing input library concentration above Illumina recommendation
steps.downstream_analysis: Bell et al. Nature 2020 pipeline (31,228 human sperm genomes)

poor_sequence_quality: Make fresh Buffer SMT and Buffer DB before Step 1
Vary BME: try 1 mM final (1 uL of 100 mM per 100 uL DB) instead of 2 mM
Pipette gently using wide-bore tips at all mixing steps

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Sperm prep (Steps 1-8), SYBR staining and count (Steps 9-10), sperm dilution through chip loading (Steps 11-15), GEM incubation and library QC (Step 16)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: Library generation branch: dilution, master mix, chip loading, GEM incubation, library QC gate

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
key_constraints_applied: Duration tokens s and m only; no h token
heat is in-place; never assigned to a variable
detect results assigned once, never reassigned
No loop constructs; freeze-thaw x3 unrolled as 6 sequential heat calls
All gate-consumed variables used exactly once
drain lowered to dispose in IR (known compiler behaviour; bs source is correct)
SpermCountAliquot_Decondensed models 1 uL sub-sample taken from post-heparinase stock; spermDecondensed flows unbroken into library path (Step 11) to preserve end-to-end dataflow
